supportFaq.accountQuestion: How do I change my email or phone number?
supportFaq.accountAnswer: Start the change in Edit Profile and verify the new contact before saving.
supportFaq.subscriptionQuestion: Where do I manage annual membership billing?
supportFaq.subscriptionAnswer: Payment and auto-renewal are managed in your App Store or Google Play account. Purchases can be restored from the Annual Membership screen.
supportFaq.bookingAnswer: No. Resort bookings are services delivered outside the app. Deposit card payments will be provided through a separate payment gateway.
supportFaq.aiQuestion: What if AI analysis fails or is incorrect?
supportFaq.aiAnswer: Check your connection and remaining credits, retry, or enter the information manually. Always review results before saving.

Operator cancellations for resort, weather, or safety reasons receive a 100% refund, processed within 5-10 business days after approval. Applicable law and mandatory consumer rights take precedence.
